patch_description: This proposal replaces the 146-parameter local ring ansatz with a strongly regularized four-parameter block. Shared global RY/RZ preparation aligns with the permutation-symmetric mean-Z readout, while complete-graph CZ coverage mirrors all 28 pairwise feature channels. Two central CRZ bridges share one parameter and add adaptive phase mixing without materially increasing model capacity. A final shared RY layer converts phase correlations into measurable Z populations. Across six independent block copies, this yields only 26 total parameters and is based on the strongest prior result: 0.96 validation/test accuracy, zero observed generalization gap, and substantially lower validation/test loss.
